def: to sixth or divide into sixths

words.word: and ye shall give the sixth part

occurrences.text: This is the oblation that ye shall offer; the sixth part of an ephah of an homer of wheat, and ye shall give the sixth part of an ephah of an homer of barley:
words: and ye shall give the sixth part
